name: MaCBench v1
protocol: MaCBench dataset v1.0.0 / results v1.0.1 fixed 1,155-question main set, official parser and retry behavior, five-run mean accuracy. Ablations are excluded.

explanation.en: Each item is binary under exact-choice or curated numeric tolerance rules; the score is accuracy over 1,155 main questions averaged across five complete runs.
explanation.zh: 每题按严格选项匹配或人工设定的数值误差规则进行二元计分；总分是在 1,155 道主测试题上五次完整运行的平均正确率。

summary.en: MaCBench measures whether vision-language models can extract, apply, and interpret visual information in chemistry and materials-science workflows.
summary.zh: MaCBench 测试视觉语言模型能否在化学与材料科研流程中提取、运用并解释视觉信息。

task_format.en: The model answers multiple-choice or numerical questions paired with scientific plots, spectra, apparatus images, tables, and structures.
task_format.zh: 模型回答与科研图表、光谱、实验装置图、数据表和结构图配套的选择题或数值题。
